name: QUT Equity Scholarships Scheme
summary: Scholarships and bursaries for domestic QUT students from low-income households, all from one application.
key: Up to $4,200 (Equity Scholarships), $1,800 (Equity Bursaries), $7,500 (Learning Potential Fund) or $10,000 (Indigenous Commonwealth Scholarships).
who: Domestic students in QUT undergraduate, postgraduate and research programs, QUT College diplomas and the University Preparation Program.
From a low-income household and in financial hardship.
need: At least two months of bank statements, as PDFs.
how: One application covers every award in the scheme.
Semester 1 applications usually open in December.
Assessment takes about a month after all documents are in.
catches: You can get one award a year: the highest one you qualify for.
The Learning Potential Fund is in the Semester 1 round only.
Not for international, single-unit or cross-institutional students.
